questionText:
Consider the following syntax-directed definition (SDD).

$S \rightarrow DHTU$$\{ S.val = D.val + H.val + T.val + U.val; \}$
$D \rightarrow \text{"M"}D_1$$\{ D.val = 5 + D_1.val; \}$
$D \rightarrow \epsilon$$\{ D.val = -5; \}$
$H \rightarrow \text{"L"}H_1$$\{ H.val = 5 * 10 + H_1.val; \}$
$H \rightarrow \epsilon$$\{ H.val = -10; \}$
$T \rightarrow \text{"C"}T_1$$\{ T.val = 5 * 100 + T_1.val; \}$
$T \rightarrow \epsilon$$\{ T.val = -5; \}$
$U \rightarrow \text{"K"}$$\{ U.val = 5; \}$

Given "MMLK" as the input, which one of the following options is the CORRECT value computed by the SDD (in the attribute $S.val$)?
explanation:
Step-by-step Evaluation of the SDD:

The input string is "MMLK".
We match the non-terminals $D, H, T, U$ to derive the input string:

1. Evaluation of $D$ for "MM":
• $D \rightarrow \text{"M"}D_1$
• $D_1 \rightarrow \text{"M"}D_2$
• $D_2 \rightarrow \epsilon$

Computing attributes bottom-up:
• $D_2.val = -5$
• $D_1.val = 5 + D_2.val = 5 + (-5) = 0$
• $D.val = 5 + D_1.val = 5 + 0 = 5$

2. Evaluation of $H$ for "L":
• $H \rightarrow \text{"L"}H_1$
• $H_1 \rightarrow \epsilon$

Computing attributes bottom-up:
• $H_1.val = -10$
• $H.val = 5 * 10 + H_1.val = 50 + (-10) = 40$

3. Evaluation of $T$ for $\epsilon$ (no 'C' in input):
• $T \rightarrow \epsilon$
• $T.val = -5$

4. Evaluation of $U$ for "K":
• $U \rightarrow \text{"K"}$
• $U.val = 5$

5. Evaluation of $S.val$:
$S.val = D.val + H.val + T.val + U.val$
$S.val = 5 + 40 + (-5) + 5 = 45$

Hence, the correct option is (A) 45.
